test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: TLOS is related to NFIM in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, VNQU is related to PHKO. To which of the given options is XPSW related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The pattern followed here is that each letter of the first term is shifted backward by 6 positions. The pattern can be summarized as **(-6, -6, -6, -6)**.

**
**For: TLOS : NFIM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83c848f0329c14c69fd47d95d9444cea5afc26986915180622ad77d7830b0f04.png] 

For**: VNQU : PHKO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04e005467bfeacde939ed436b3a4eb28993b03fc0d32a5805fcea15757cbed23.png] 

**Applying the same logic to XPSW:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9287862615c74d5db6071c243a7441076772633de9a62ea10d0147b216b03107.png] 

Thus, XPSW is related to RJMQ.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**.
